entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand. It's a piece of junk.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To best assist you, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not working. That's the issue. I've charged it, I've done everything. It won't sync with my phone, it won't do anything.
Okay, I understand. So you believe the device might be broken or defective?
I'd say a product that's completely defective qualifies as broken, yes.
Of course, I apologize for the trouble. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I get your last name and the order number, please?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 11 days ago. Let me just check our policy for a defective item.
Alright, I've checked the system. Good news - you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can definitely cannot offer a refund for you right now.
Whatever. About time something worked. Just send me the label.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and again, I apologize for the inconvenience with your band.
